scripts.copy-openmct: rm -rf public/openmct && mkdir -p public/openmct && cp -r node_modules/openmct/dist/. public/openmct/
scripts.build: npm run copy-openmct && vite build && npm run copy-maplibre-worker
scripts.copy-maplibre-worker: cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-shared.mjs dist/assets/ && test -s dist/assets/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs && test -s dist/assets/maplibre-gl-shared.mjs
